description: Top-level Custom SQL datasource (<relation type='text'> directly under <connection>, NOT the object-model collection form). This is the classic/legacy Custom SQL shape (e.g. the EDNA PODVIEW workbook, 2026-07). Before the fix the MCP converter's relType chain (table/join/collection) had no 'text' branch, so the whole datasource fell through and produced ZERO elements. Fix emits a kind:'sql' element with the statement preserved verbatim and columns self-referencing via the [Custom SQL/<COL>] keyword. Targets TJ.PUBLIC.SUPERSTORE_ORDERS for portability.
